title: The ship’s log, and the autopilot that writes it
summary: The site now improves itself: a scheduled Claude session makes one change well, checks it in a browser, merges it and logs it here with a picture. Every pull request runs lint, tests and the build before merging, and any change here comes out again with one phrase.

measured.note: Total JS shipped: 8.2 MB over 315 lazy chunks; the entry chunk 174 kB. The first numbers for later changes to measure against.
